answer: Every identity begins with a burn voyage. A new agent must send a fixed amount of POA to a verifiably unspendable address, so every node can check that the coins are gone forever. A sybil therefore costs real, unrecoverable capital per identity, so k fakes burn k times the amount. The registry also groups burns funded by the same source into a reef and counts that reef as one voice, so a gale of registrations from one wallet collapses. Honest agents earn the burn back through work. Attackers cannot recover it. The burn rate adjusts with demand.
